dimensions.label: Hardware
dimensions.description: Camera/vision, audio, microphones, battery, weight, thermals, build quality, and core physical capability. Display performance is graded separately.

dimensions.label: Wearability
dimensions.description: Looks like glasses, comfort, size, discretion, fit, and everyday practicality.

dimensions.label: Visual AI
dimensions.description: Can the glasses understand what the wearer is looking at and turn visual context into useful machine understanding?

dimensions.label: Software
dimensions.description: App quality, stability, features, updates, integrations, and day-to-day software experience.

dimensions.label: Display / HUD
dimensions.description: Readability, resolution, brightness, field of view, color, monocular/binocular implementation, information density, outdoor usability, and integration into the wearer's view.

dimensions.label: Openness
dimensions.description: SDK/API access, sensor access, documentation, open-source components, and supported developer access.

dimensions.label: Owner Control
dimensions.description: Sideloading, replaceable AI, local processing, custom endpoints, and the owner's ability to choose the intelligence layer.

dimensions.label: Cloud Independence
dimensions.description: What continues working without the manufacturer's servers, account services, or cloud AI.

dimensions.label: Hackability
dimensions.description: BLE access, firmware access, reverse-engineering potential, sideloading paths, exposed interfaces, and community tooling.

dimensions.label: Value
dimensions.description: Useful capability relative to purchase price.
